title: Colts survive late Dolphins rally to snap 5-game drought

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts survive late Dolphins rally to snap 5-game drought
sources.description: The Indianapolis Colts found a way to scrape through a 24-22 win over the Miami Dolphins inside Lucas Oil Stadium, dodging a pair of missed field goals to snap a five-game drought. Behind a punishing backfield tandem and a timely defensive touchdown, the Colts outlasted the Dolphins to secure their third victory of the 2026 […]
